newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $101/dressed, off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $101/dressed, off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a dressed basis were steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Buyer inquiry fairly good. Seller interest modest. Sales confirmed - 1,500 For the week - 50,500

Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights). Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - 100.00-101.00. Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1175 lbs - 100.00-101.00.
